sin.name: request-outside-transport
sin.description: Viewer code reaches the server itself, by fetch, an EventSource, an XMLHttpRequest or a beacon, around the one funnel every request goes through, so its request is never joined with one in flight, never counted, never retried and never told the journal is updating.
sin.rule: Every request the viewer makes goes through the transport (src/web/src/api/transport.js), reached through a read or a write the API client declares; a file the build carries, and the phone app's and the share page's own addresses, go through transport.raw. The files in src/web/public are left out: the phone app's service worker runs apart from the viewer and cannot reach its transport, and the Draco decoder there is a library the build copies as it is.
